You are producing the AUTHORITATIVE design system spec that Koda will implement. The rebuild target is Linear/Vercel/Resend aesthetic — dark-first, monochrome + single accent, dense, premium typography, 150ms motion.

Write it as a single markdown spec file with concrete values (hex/oklch, px/rem, names). This is implementation-ready, not exploratory.

## Context you must load
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/app/globals.css (current tokens)
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/components.json (shadcn config)
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/app/layout.tsx (font loading)
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/components/ui/button.tsx, card.tsx, input.tsx, badge.tsx (current shadcn primitives)
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/components/app/sidebar/AppSidebar.tsx
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/components/shared/ScoreRing.tsx
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/tsconfig.json

## Audit findings to fix (from Vega's recent audit)
Key issues to resolve in the spec:
- --radius is 0.75rem, should be 0.5rem (Vercel-tight)
- --color-accent and --color-secondary are identical (dead affordance)
- --color-success / --color-warning exist but unused; hardcoded emerald/amber/red everywhere
- 5 distinct radius values, 3+ card variants, 2 shadow systems (admin vs user)
- Sidebar tokens have no dark-mode override (hardcoded dark)
- Double font load (next/font + @import in globals.css)
- text-[10px], text-[11px], text-[15px] arbitrary — need a scale
- Hardcoded hex in Recharts (#6366f1, #22c55e, #ef4444) — not themable
- bg-white, bg-slate-50, border-slate-200 hardcodes break dark mode
- No shared StatusBadge — composed inline in 8+ places
- Two separate KPI card implementations on admin
- Sidebar has 10 flat items, needs grouping

## Design DNA from Nova (steal from)
- Linear: ~220px sidebar, 36px row tables, no borders, hover reveals, 150ms ease-out, 95% monochrome + accent
- Vercel: sparklines inline, gradient-fill line charts, terminal-style logs with severity left border
- Resend: minimal 200px sidebar, side-drawer details, empty-state = onboarding
- Open-source reference: dub.co (shadcn + Next.js Linear-style)
- Differentiating moves to enable: (1) Streaming scan log in terminal panel, (2) Cmd+K command palette

## Deliverable: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md

Write a single file with these sections. Every value concrete, ready to paste.

### 1. Color tokens (OKLCH + HSL fallback)
- Background layers (canvas, surface, raised, overlay) — light + dark
- Foreground (primary text, secondary, tertiary, disabled)
- Border (subtle, default, strong)
- Brand accent (single color — pick one: electric blue like Linear #5e6ad2, or Vercel black/white, or something CROBOT-specific). Justify the pick.
- Semantic: success, warning, danger, info (with /subtle, /default, /emphasis steps)
- Status colors for scan states (pending, running, completed, failed)
- Sidebar tokens (light + dark mode defined)

Give exact values. Show the full `@theme inline` block + `.dark {}` block for globals.css.

### 2. Typography scale
- Font families: Inter (UI) + Geist Mono (code/data) via next/font
- Size scale (use rem): 11px/0.6875, 12px/0.75, 13px/0.8125, 14px/0.875, 16px/1, 18px/1.125, 20px/1.25, 24px/1.5, 30px/1.875, 36px/2.25, 48px/3
- Weight scale: 400 regular, 500 medium, 600 semibold, 700 bold
- Line-height pairings for each size
- Tailwind custom utilities to define (e.g., text-xs-tight for 12/16 vs text-xs for 12/18)
- Heading specs: h1/h2/h3/h4 with size+weight+letterspacing

### 3. Spacing scale
- Base unit (4px)
- Named spacing: xs/sm/md/lg/xl/2xl/3xl with concrete px values
- Page padding rule (mobile/tablet/desktop)
- Card interior padding (sm/default/lg)
- Section vertical rhythm (how to space major sections — space-y-6 vs space-y-8)

### 4. Radii
- --radius = 0.5rem base
- Mapping: sm = calc(var(--radius) - 4px), md = calc(var(--radius) - 2px), lg = var(--radius), xl = calc(var(--radius) + 4px)
- Component assignments: badge/pill = full, input/button = md, card = lg, dialog = xl

### 5. Shadows
- Single system (kill the dual admin/user split)
- Levels: none, xs, sm, md, lg, xl
- Values: subtle 1px border + very soft shadow (Linear style), not heavy
- Component assignments: card = shadow-xs, dialog = shadow-lg, popover = shadow-md

### 6. Motion
- Duration tokens: instant 50ms, fast 150ms, base 200ms, slow 300ms
- Easing tokens: ease-out (default), ease-in-out (panels), spring (sparingly)
- Component assignments: hover 150ms, panel open 200ms, page transition 150ms

### 7. Components spec
For each, give variant + size + state specs:
- Button (default/outline/ghost/destructive × sm/md/lg)
- Input + Select + Textarea (heights, focus rings)
- Card (default/elevated/interactive, padding variants)
- Badge (new shared component — neutral/success/warning/danger/info × sm/md)
- StatusBadge (NEW — for scan states: pending/running/completed/failed with dot indicator)
- EmptyState (icon/illustration/title/description/cta slots)
- Dialog / Sheet (right drawer preferred for details — Linear-style)
- Table (row heights 36/40/48, hover, selected states)
- Command palette (Cmd+K pattern using cmdk package)
- Sidebar (collapsed 56px, expanded 240px — define group labels, item states)
- ScoreRing (hero 180px vs pillar 80px variants, stroke widths, color-by-score rule)
- Progress (heights 2/4/6, colors by score)

### 8. Page compositions (1-2 line each)
- Dashboard: "Hero score ring row + 4-KPI grid + recent scans table + activity feed. Mobile: 2 KPIs + table."
- Scan: "Centered single form card with URL + device picker + primary CTA. During scan: terminal-style streaming log panel replaces form."
- Reports list: "Dense Linear-style table. 5 cols mobile-hide to 3. Filter chips row above. Pagination."
- Report detail: "Hero score ring + 7 pillar grid + tabbed findings (horizontal scroll tabs). Side drawer for each finding."
- Settings: "Left subnav (Profile/Billing/API/Notifications) + right content. No tabs."
- Admin dashboard: "Activity feed left 2/3 + KPI stack right 1/3 + chart row below. Not dual-stacked KPIs."

### 9. What's killed
- All `bg-white`, `bg-slate-*`, `border-slate-*`, hardcoded hex
- Old `--radius: 0.75rem`
- Duplicate `--color-accent`/`--color-secondary`
- `text-[10px]`, `text-[11px]`, `text-[15px]`
- Admin's `shadow-sm` separate system
- Google Fonts `@import` line in globals.css
- `WhatsNewBanner` (already gone)
- Non-Linear rounded-2xl / rounded-3xl usage

### 10. Implementation order for Koda
Dependency graph — what must be done first, what can parallelize.

Write the full file. Under 3000 words. Every value concrete. No "consider" or "maybe" language — this is a spec, not a proposal.

content.text:
`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md` — written. 10 sections, all values concrete.

Key decisions locked in:

**Accent:** Electric Indigo `oklch(62% 0.21 264)` / `#5e6ad2` — identical to Linear's brand hue, differentiated from every CRO competitor (Hotjar orange, Crazy Egg red, Clarity grey), passes 4.5:1 on dark surfaces.

**Critical fixes captured:**
- `--radius` corrected to `0.5rem` (8px) — kills rounded-2xl/3xl across all cards
- `--color-accent` and `--color-secondary` are now distinct tokens serving distinct roles
- All 4 semantic colors (`success`/`warning`/`danger`/`info`) get 3-step systems (`subtle`/`default`/`emphasis`) so Badge, ScoreRing, and charts all resolve from vars — zero hardcoded hex in app code
- Sidebar gets named dark-mode tokens; no more `text-white/55` opacity hacks
- Google Fonts `@import` deleted — Inter already loads via `next/font`
- Type scale replaces all `text-[Npx]` arbitrary values with named utilities
- Recharts gets a `useChartColors()` hook pattern
- StatusBadge is a new shared primitive; the 8+ inline compositions die
- Two KPI card implementations collapse into one
- Sidebar's 10 flat items reorganized into 4 labeled groups

**Implementation order** in §10 is a dependency graph — Step 1 (tokens) is the hard blocker; Steps 2/3/5 can parallelize internally.
